title: Susegad UI registry item manifest
description: One registry.json per package, scene, component, recipe or adapter folder; a folder that holds a second item names it <name>.registry.json. It tells the CLI which files to copy into a builder's project. Paths in files, docs and prompt are relative to the folder the manifest sits in. Repo-rooted paths that start with packages/ are still accepted while older manifests move over, and the build prints a note when it sees one. The index the build writes (registry/registry.json) is described by $defs.index.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Scenes are scene-<name>, for example scene-kolam.
name.x-hint: should be lowercase kebab-case, like scene-kolam

stability.description: experimental: may change or move without notice. beta: the contract is settling; breaking it gets a changelog entry. stable: covered by the semver rules in the roadmap.

useForTag.description: A short, honest tag for where this piece fits well: for example hero, loader, empty-state, 404, divider, section-break, background or story. Not a closed list; add one only where the piece's own description already supports it.
useForTag.x-hint: should be a short kebab-case tag, like hero or section-break

relPath.description: A forward-slash path inside the repo. No leading slash, no backslashes, no .. segments.
relPath.x-hint: should be a forward-slash path inside the repo, with no leading slash, no drive letter and no ..

hash.description: sha256 of the content in hex, with CRLF line endings read as LF so a checkout on Windows hashes the same.

jsBytes.description: Unminified source bytes of this item's own .js and .mjs files.

firstSightBytes.description: A scape only (decision 0020, amended): the most code (comments stripped) its first sight may load before the finished still is on screen, at most 65536.

reason.description: Why this item's budget differs from the default for its type (see docs/decisions/0001-architecture.md, Budgets).

stabilityReason.description: Required for beta or stable: one line saying why.

motif.description: For a piece drawn from a cultural tradition: where it comes from, how everyday or ceremonial it is, and one honest sentence about it. The gate batch lints this field.

npmDependencies.description: npm packages the CLI adds to the consumer's package.json, name to exact version, matching the library's own package.json (decision 0017).

tier.description: "scape": a scene budgeted on its first sight rather than its total (decision 0020).

entry.description: A scape only: the files its first sight loads from. What they import statically counts; a dynamic import() is the seam to the rest.

motif.description: For a piece drawn from a cultural tradition: where it comes from, how everyday or ceremonial it is, and one honest sentence about it. The gate batch lints this field.

codeBytes.description: jsBytes with comments and blank lines taken out (decision 0002).

firstSightBytes.description: A scape only: the code bytes (comments stripped, as codeBytes) of its own files that its entry reaches by static imports (decision 0020, amended).

index.description: registry/registry.json, written by registry/build.mjs. Sorted and free of timestamps, so the same sources always give the same bytes.

base.description: Where file paths are rooted, relative to the index file's folder.
